title: Quitting Smoking
subtitle: Health effects, risk reduction, and evidence-based considerations for quitting smoking.
evidence_strength: Established evidence from multiple clinical trials and meta-analyses supports the health benefits of quitting smoking and effectiveness of combined pharmacotherapy and behavioral support. Evidence on e-cigarettes as cessation aids is moderate and evolving, with some uncertainty regarding long-term safety. Misconceptions addressed here are based on clinical observations and population data.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
